notes.title: Stillwater Remastered is Live!
notes.notes:
Stillwater Remastered is finally out!! After pouring our hearts out once more, what was supposed to be a small, short-story game became something even more! Honestly, I am more than grateful for all the love and support we received over the years. Even now, I would see people on our itch.io and steam pages leaving behind some comforting and encouraging messages! It warms my heart to see them! 
Once again, thank you to everyone who has followed and supported us on this journey! We hope you have fun and enjoy our game! Till next time!!
